#042 · Bat Pokémon

Golbat

Poison Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Golbat is a Poison/Flying-type Bat Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 55 kg. It evolves from Zubat and into Crobat. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 455.
